data.title: TD Synnex CEO: BlueStar Acquisition, Kuka Robotics Pact Fuel New Physical AI Push
data.description: TD Synnex CEO Patrick Zammit told CRN that the distributor is moving big into physical AI with its BlueStar acquisition and Kuka robotics distribution agreement.
data.author: Joseph F. Kovar
